data.one_liner: Overlay animation between two widgets using a controller and global keys
data.what_it_does: Provides AnimateTo and AnimateFrom widgets that animate a source widget to a target widget as an overlay. The controller triggers the animation and can transport data to the target.
use_when: You need a simple, declarative overlay animation between two widgets
You want to animate a widget to a target without custom animation code
You need to pass data along with the animation
avoid_when: You need complex physics or custom animation curves not supported by the package
You require animations that persist across navigation or need state restoration
strengths: Easy to use with minimal boilerplate
Supports data transfer between source and target
weaknesses: Very new, no advanced features yet
No support for complex animation curves or physics
data.setup_notes: Add dependency and import package, create controller, wrap widgets with AnimateTo/AnimateFrom

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a broader set of animation helpers and effects

alternatives.name: rive
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers advanced animation and physics-based motion
